title: GET /api/projects/:id/milestones — list milestones
description: Return all milestones for a project, ordered by sort_order ascending.
acceptanceCriteria: Returns milestones ordered by sort_order ASC
Returns empty array if no milestones exist
Returns 404 if project not found or unauthorized

steps.details: getOwnedProject(id, userId). Query milestones WHERE project_id = id ORDER BY sort_order ASC. Return 200 with array.
Create 3 milestones, GET them — verify correct order. Try for another user's project — expect 404.
